name: awkward-open-youth-M1010
finalText:
I opened a Youth sub-account for member M-1010 (Yuri Savchenko), and the site's confirmation page says it was created.

- **Member ID:** M-1010
- **Selected account type:** Youth
- **Confirmation status:** Success. The page text after the final step read "Done – Sub-account M-1010-S1 (Youth) created for Yuri Savchenko. Simulated."

The new sub-account ID is M-1010-S1. The confirmation includes the word "Simulated", so the site presents this as a simulated creation.

Before I acted, M-1010's profile showed "Sub-accounts: none". I didn't go back to the profile afterward to check that the sub-account is listed there. The confirmation message is the only evidence of creation.
